metadata.title: Karel Kutchan — Senior Frontend Engineer
metadata.description: Karel Kutchan is a senior frontend engineer based in Prague, building resilient frontend systems with React, TypeScript and Next.js.

hero.headline: I build frontend systems for products that have to last.

paragraphs.experience: More than ten years in web development, currently in a lead frontend role. I work with React, TypeScript and Next.js across customer portals, internal enterprise applications and the component libraries underneath them.

responsibility.heading: What I owned
responsibility.body: Frontend architecture, component foundations, accessibility, testing strategy, review quality and team guidance.

decisions.heading: The decisions that mattered
decisions.body: Establish reusable boundaries, keep component behavior accessible, and use Storybook and browser tests where they reduce regression risk.

outcome.heading: What changed
outcome.body: A more coherent frontend foundation for continued product delivery. No invented performance or business metrics are claimed.

reflection.heading: What I would carry forward
reflection.body: Strong frontend work leaves the next change easier to reason about. The durable result is a clearer system, not only a shipped screen.

descriptions.leadership: Leading frontend architecture, delivery practices and technical decisions across product teams.

kontentAi.title: Frontend Engineer
kontentAi.summary: Accessibility engineering inside the Kontent.ai CMS product itself.

descriptions.product: Worked on accessibility inside the Kontent.ai CMS product — the application content teams use daily, not a site built on top of it.
descriptions.reactAria: Rebuilt interaction patterns with React Aria hooks, adding custom solutions where the library did not cover the requirement.
descriptions.depth: Reviewed landmarks, labels, focus behavior and component semantics as part of the design, instead of treating accessibility as a final QA step.
descriptions.safety: Kept a large refactor safe with maintainable TypeScript components, Storybook workflows and Playwright checks.

tldrit.title: Lead Frontend Engineer
tldrit.summary: Led frontend delivery for web and mobile applications in a time-framed role.

descriptions.leadership: As a Lead Frontend Engineer in a time-framed role, I designed and implemented solutions for web and mobile applications while leading the frontend team.
descriptions.delivery: I proposed technical approaches, developed scalable applications using ReactJS, Next.js, and Storybook, and ensured high-quality, user-friendly results within tight deadlines.

eman.title: Frontend Developer
eman.summary: Frontend delivery for energy-sector clients — E.ON, MND, ČEZ and Bohemia Energy.

descriptions.mnd: Built Moje MND, a customer self-service portal, from scratch in a two-person frontend team — forms, validation, tabular overviews, invoices, contracts and document handling.
descriptions.eon: Delivered two internal E.ON applications: PUDplus for work orders, findings and preventive maintenance, and MKME web for work orders and metering.
descriptions.designSystems: Built and maintained the @eman/mnd-storybook and @eman/pud-storybook component libraries, plus a design system for Bohemia Energy.
descriptions.collaboration: Collaborated closely with UX designers and backend developers to meet client expectations.

lmc.title: Frontend Developer
lmc.summary: Built bespoke, responsive web solutions for corporate clients.

descriptions.solutions: Focused on creating bespoke web solutions for corporate clients, delivering tailored solutions for platforms like jobs.cz.
descriptions.discovery: Collaborated with designers and clients to analyze requirements and design functional, visually appealing solutions.
descriptions.technology: Used modern frontend technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and React, ensuring responsive design and high performance.
descriptions.accessibility: Prioritized accessibility standards and optimized user experience across devices and browsers.

ampX.title: Frontend Developer
ampX.summary: Developed the frontend of a distributed-energy product.

descriptions.platform: Worked on the frontend of a new digital energy platform enabling distributed energy participation.
descriptions.quality: Delivered high-quality, accessible, and responsive UI while maintaining clean and readable code.
descriptions.technology: Used technologies such as ReactJS, Material-UI, Vanilla JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS-in-JS (JSS) to develop and implement frontend solutions.

skype.title: Frontend Developer
skype.summary: Contributed to the accessible and responsive Skype.com web platform.

descriptions.scale: Contributed to a platform serving over 400,000 daily users from more than 30 countries.
descriptions.quality: Focused on ensuring accessibility, responsiveness, and performance of the main website.
descriptions.components: Developed and optimized components, improved usability, and maintained clean, maintainable code.
descriptions.cms: Worked closely with Kentico CMS to manage and integrate content.

foxconn.title: Frontend Coder
foxconn.summary: Developed responsive interfaces and a BEM-based component foundation.

descriptions.gui: Developed the GUI with a strong focus on HTML architecture and responsive design.
descriptions.collaboration: Collaborated with designers and developers to implement modern CSS and JavaScript solutions.
descriptions.technology: Worked with React, Vanilla JS, and occasionally jQuery.
descriptions.designSystem: Developed a custom design system based on the BEM framework.

mountfield.title: Frontend Coder
mountfield.summary: Maintained the main website and delivered supporting marketing and internal interfaces.

descriptions.website: Managed and maintained the company's main website built on the Kentico platform.
descriptions.microsites: Created microsites and supported marketing websites, and developed responsive HTML newsletters.
descriptions.internalApps: Contributed to internal application development to improve employee workflows and customer access.
